generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In the `AVLGroupTree` constructor, the `finally` block calls `Releasables.close(tree, centroids, aggregatedCounts)`, but it omits the `counts` array. If an exception occurs during construction after `counts` has been allocated but before the local variables are nullified, the `counts` array will not be released, leading to a resource leak.

review_comment: Digests _should_ always be created now with the `static create()` methods for correct accounting, so I tried to make most things `private` if possible
Note that this isn't a static class, as I just moved the anonymous class from the constructor. So this class doesn't have a `static create()` method, and it's in the parent class instead
